vulnerability_type: Access-control bypass / OOB (hardware DMA confused deputy)
summary: SCE DMA authorizes by caller segid (scedma_ac) but computes cryptoram address as SEGCFGS[segid].segaddr + caller segptr with no bounds check against segsize; a caller allowed a benign segment can point into key segments.
malicious_actor: less-trusted on-chip master using the general/non-secure SCE DMA channel (xch, axim_gnl) whose access rules deny reads of key segments
parameter: cr_segptrstart (APB SFR 0x20 xch / 0x40 sch / 0x58 ich) with cr_segid (0x1c/0x3c/0x54)
trigger_flow: program xchcr.segid=readable seg + xchcr.segstart=(keybase-segbase) + axstart=ext buf -> xchstart -> scedmachnl_axim -> scedma_chnl -> sce_memc addr=base+ptr -> reads key words to external AXI
malicious_input_example: segid=SEGID_AOB(0x0f), segstart chosen so segaddr+segptr=SEGADDR_KEY, func=read-out

summary: devmode input OR fuse byte nvrcfg[28] sets 5 bypass bits incl mode-quit RAM clear bypass (keys persist into non-secure mode where scedma_ac is disabled) and NVR-driven access-rule override (nvrcfg[29]==0x5a swaps hardwired ACRULEs).
malicious_actor: attacker who can set devmode or influence NVR/fuse provisioning
trigger_flow: devmode/nvrcfg[28] -> devmode_sce='1 -> modequit bypass -> no ram clear on secure->non-secure -> acenable=0 full access to resident keys
malicious_input_example: nvrcfg[28] bit1 set; or nvrcfg[29]=0x5a with attacker rules

summary: HMAC/secret check verdict chkprepass initializes to 1(pass) and is only cleared when a compared word is nonzero, updated only on segwr; if the compare phase completes without word-writes streaming (suppressed/zero-length transfer or glitch), chkpass=1 vacuously and sce_ts sets trust bit kid. Verdict fails open.
malicious_actor: fault-injection / control-path attacker against secure boot
trigger_flow: MFSM_LD_SECRET: chkprepass init 1 -> compare words -> chkdone -> chkpass=chkdone&&chkprepass -> hmac_pass -> sce_ts tsreg[kid]=1
malicious_input_example: skip/suppress the compare writes so chkprepass stays 1; or glitch the write-enable during MFSM_LD_SECRET
